description: This file is a C++ source file implementing front panel LED control and blinking functionalities, including power state management, LED brightness, and pattern-based blinking sequences.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel indicators, blinking patterns, and power state interactions.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure representing blinking pattern details for LEDs.

classes.name: FrontPanelBlinkInfo
classes.description: Structure holding individual blink pattern parameters such as color, brightness, and duration.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for CFrontPanel, initializes hardware and power state.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and resets singleton instance.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the front panel indicator control, initializes LEDs.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timers and indicator updates.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the front panel LEDs.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Sets color and brightness for a specific LED indicator.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for LEDs based on JSON input.

methods.name: startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Begins blinking sequence with specified repeat count.

methods.name: setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets LED color and brightness for a blink pattern.

methods.name: onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback for handling blinking timer events.
